series.name: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)
series.notes: Manual section 7 'EventList information', Table 7-1 Eventlist. High PK relevance - single-phase residential hybrid with EPS backup. Rows unique to THIS table: ID032 OffgridGroundFault, ID045 CTDisconnect, ID046 PVReversalConnect, ID047 ParallelFault, ID056 NTCConnectFault, ID094 LoadShortCircuit, ID107 HwVerError, ID108 GenStartupFail, ID109 GeneratorOverload, ID125 'Battery discharge protection', ID144 PermGridRlyFail, ID151 BatPartOffline, ID158 BatLowVolt, ID186-ID188 battery temperature protections. Never merged with SERIES 5.

title.ur: Off-grid / EPS earth fault - backup circuit mein earth fault (ID032)

meaning.en: An earth fault was detected while the inverter was supplying the backup (off-grid) circuit. This row exists only on the EP single-phase table.
meaning.ur: Jab inverter backup (off-grid) circuit ko power de raha tha tab earth fault detect hua. Yeh row sirf EP single-phase table par hai.

causes.en: Leakage to earth in the EPS/load wiring - water in a junction box on the load side.
causes.ur: EPS/load wiring mein earth leakage - load side ke junction box mein paani.

causes.en: Load-side cable pinched or a damaged appliance pulling current to earth.
causes.ur: Load side ka cable pinch hua ya koi damaged appliance earth mein current kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker and isolate the EPS/load panel completely.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke EPS/load panel ko mukammal tarah isolate karein.

solutions.en: Test the backup load wiring to earth with an insulation tester, one circuit at a time.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se backup load wiring ko earth ke saath ek ek circuit karke test karein.

solutions.en: Locate the leaky circuit or appliance, repair it, and only then re-enable the EPS output.
solutions.ur: Leaky circuit ya dhoop dhundh kar theek karein, us ke baad hi EPS output dobara on karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: CT error / CT disconnect - current transformer ka signal nahi (ID045)

meaning.en: The current transformer is not delivering a usable signal. Manual action: check whether the CT wiring is correct.
meaning.ur: Current transformer se qabil-e-istemal signal nahi aa raha. Manual ka action: check karein ke CT wiring sahi hai ya nahi.

causes.en: CT lead loose, not seated, or connected to the wrong port.
causes.ur: CT lead loose, seat nahi hua, ya galat port par connected.

causes.en: CT clamp not closed, or mounted on the wrong conductor / reversed.
causes.ur: CT clamp band nahi, ya galat conductor par / ulti taraf lagi.

solutions.en: Switch off AC breaker and check the CT wiring per the manual, including the port pinout.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke manual ke mutabiq CT wiring check karein, port pinout samet.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT clamp arrow points with grid current flow and that the clamp closes fully.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT clamp ki arrow grid current flow ki taraf hai aur clamp poori tarah band hota hai.

solutions.en: Verify the inverter CT type setting matches the fitted CT and re-check the LCD current reading.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki CT type setting fitted CT se match karwayein aur LCD current reading dobara dekhein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Parallel connection error - parallel wiring ya setting ghalat (ID047)

meaning.en: Parallel operation is enabled but the parallel network is not correctly wired or the parallel setting on the LCD is wrong. Manual lists two checks for this row.
meaning.ur: Parallel operation on hai magar parallel network sahi se wired nahi ya LCD ka parallel setting ghalat hai. Manual is row ke liye do check batata hai.

causes.en: Parallel cable not correctly connected between the units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan parallel cable sahi se connected nahi.

causes.en: Parallel setting on the LCD left disabled or set to the wrong channel.
causes.ur: LCD ka parallel setting disable chhoda ya galat channel par set.

solutions.en: Check whether the parallel cable is correctly connected between the two units.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel cable do units ke darmiyan sahi se connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Then check whether the parallel setting on the LCD is correct and enabled.
solutions.ur: Phir check karein ke LCD ka parallel setting theek aur on hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Power the master on first, then the slave, so each finds its role.
solutions.ur: Pehle master on karein, phir slave, takay har apna role dhoondh le.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: NTC temperature sensor error - battery ka NTC sensor kharab (ID056)

meaning.en: The battery NTC temperature sensor connection is faulty, so the inverter cannot safely charge or discharge the battery. Manual action: check whether the NTC is properly connected.
meaning.ur: Battery NTC temperature sensor ka connection kharab hai, is liye inverter battery ko safely charge ya discharge nahi kar sakta. Manual ka action: check karein ke NTC theek se connected hai ya nahi.

causes.en: NTC lead not plugged into the COM port, or the plug is only half in.
causes.ur: NTC lead COM port mein plug nahi, ya plug aadha hi baitha hai.

causes.en: NTC cable pinched, cut, or corroded at the sensor end.
causes.ur: NTC cable pinch hui, kat gayi, ya sensor side par corroded.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and check whether the NTC is properly connected in the COM port.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke dekhein ke NTC COM port mein theek se connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure NTC resistance with a multimeter at ambient temperature and compare with the sensor's specification curve.
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature par multimeter se NTC resistance measure karke sensor ke specification curve se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the NTC lead or sensor if the reading is out of range or the connector is heat-damaged.
solutions.ur: Reading range se bahar ho ya connector garmi se kharab ho to NTC lead ya sensor replace karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: EPS load short circuit protection - backup load par short (ID094)

meaning.en: The inverter detected a short circuit on the EPS/LOAD output and cut backup power. Manual remedy: after three detections wait 30 minutes before re-entering off-grid mode, and check the AC LOAD port connection.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne EPS/LOAD output par short circuit detect karke backup power kaat diya. Manual ka hal: teen detections ke baad off-grid mode mein dobara jaane se pehle 30 minute intezaar karein, aur AC LOAD port ki connection check karein.

causes.en: A shorted appliance or a failed capacitor on the backup load panel.
causes.ur: Backup load panel par koi short hua appliance ya capacitor fail.

causes.en: Incorrect or loose wiring at the AC LOAD terminal block.
causes.ur: AC LOAD terminal block par galat ya loose wiring.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC LOAD panel and disconnect loads one by one to find the shorted item.
solutions.ur: AC LOAD panel isolate karke loads ek ek karke disconnect karein takay short hua item mil jaye.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC LOAD port is connected correctly, as the manual directs, including PE and neutral.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq check karein ke AC LOAD port theek se connected hai, PE aur neutral samet.

solutions.en: After three detections, wait the full 30 minutes the manual specifies before re-entering off-grid mode.
solutions.ur: Teen detections ke baad manual ke bataye poore 30 minute intezaar karein, phir off-grid mode mein wapas jayein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Generator startup failure - generator start nahi ho raha (ID108)

meaning.en: In generator mode the inverter could not start output, usually because the generator did not come up to a usable voltage/frequency. Manual gives two checks.
meaning.ur: Generator mode mein inverter ne output start nahi kiya, aam tor par is liye ke generator qabil-e-istemal voltage/frequency tak nahi aaya. Manual do check batata hai.

causes.en: Generator not in a good condition - low fuel, failed starter, or a tripped breaker.
causes.ur: Generator theek haal mein nahi - fuel kam, starter kharab, ya breaker trip.

causes.en: Generator and inverter not properly connected, or wrong generator mode configuration.
causes.ur: Generator aur inverter theek se jure nahi, ya generator mode ki configuration ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the generator is in good condition - fuel, oil, cooling, air filter, and its own breaker.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke generator theek haal mein hai - fuel, oil, cooling, air filter, aur us ka apna breaker.

solutions.en: Then check whether the generator and inverter are properly connected at the AC side.
solutions.ur: Phir check karein ke generator aur inverter AC side par theek se jure hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the generator mode is enabled correctly and the generator start-up time/voltage settings suit the genset.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke generator mode theek enable hai aur generator start-up time/voltage settings genset ke mutabiq hain.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Battery low voltage alarm - battery voltage low par (ID124)

meaning.en: The battery voltage has fallen to the low threshold. Manual action: check whether the battery voltage of the inverter is too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage low threshold tak gir gaya hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke inverter ki battery voltage bohat kam to nahi.

causes.en: Battery genuinely discharged with no PV surplus to recharge it.
causes.ur: Battery sach mein discharge ho gaya aur recharge karne ke liye PV surplus nahi tha.

causes.en: Load running continuously in EPS/backup mode draining the pack overnight.
causes.ur: Load aksar EPS/backup mode mein chalta raha aur raat bhar pack drain kar gaya.

solutions.en: Read battery voltage and SOC on the LCD, and measure pack voltage at the BAT terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur SOC padhein, aur BAT terminals par multimeter se pack voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured voltage with the battery's minimum operating voltage from its datasheet.
solutions.ur: Measured voltage ko battery ke datasheet ki minimum operating voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is healthy, adjust the low-voltage cutoff and depth-of-discharge settings in the advanced menu.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage theek hai to advanced menu mein low-voltage cutoff aur depth-of-discharge settings theek karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Battery discharge prohibited - BMS ne discharge block kar di (ID125)

meaning.en: Protection is blocking battery discharge to protect the cells. This EP table's ID125 is named differently from the HYD 3PH table's ID125 - kept separate.
meaning.ur: Cells bachane ke liye protection ne battery discharge block kar diya. Is EP table ka ID125 HYD 3PH table ke ID125 se alag naam rakhta hai - alag rakha gaya hai.

causes.en: SOC already at the configured lower cutoff - normal end of discharge.
causes.ur: SOC configured lower cutoff par pahunch chuka hai - ye normal discharge ka ant hai.

causes.en: One or more cells below the cell-level undervoltage limit (pack imbalance).
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada cells cell-level undervoltage limit se neeche (pack imbalance).

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the safe discharge window.
causes.ur: Battery temperature safe discharge window se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Read the SOC on the LCD; at the lower cutoff this message is expected and needs no repair.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC padhein; lower cutoff par ye message aana expected hai aur koi marammat zaroori nahi.

solutions.en: If SOC is high but discharge is blocked, measure pack voltage and check battery temperature.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC zyada hai phir bhi discharge block hai to pack voltage aur battery temperature check karein.

solutions.en: A blocked discharge at healthy SOC and normal temperature points to a BMS or cell-balance fault.
solutions.ur: Healthy SOC aur normal temperature par blocked discharge BMS ya cell-balance ki ghalti batata hai.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Permanent grid relay failure - grid relay permanently fail (ID144)

meaning.en: The grid-side relay has latched into a permanent failure, so the inverter cannot connect to the grid without service. This code is unique to the EP table.
meaning.ur: Grid side relay permanent failure mein chala gaya, is liye service ke baghair inverter grid se connect nahi ho sakta. Yeh code sirf EP table par hai.

causes.en: Grid relay contacts welded from a short or repeated overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Short ya baar baar ke overcurrent event se grid relay ke contacts juce hue.

causes.en: Relay coil or its drive circuit failed.
causes.ur: Relay coil ya us ka drive circuit fail.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, and attempt one clean restart to confirm it is not a false latch.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karein, aur ye confirm karne ke liye ek saaf restart karein ke latch asal mein hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, inspect the grid relay connector and socket for pushed-back or burnt pins.
solutions.ur: Power off karke grid relay connector aur socket mein dhakle ya jale pins dekhein.

solutions.en: Because this is a permanent fault, replace the grid relay through a service centre and log it for the warranty claim.
solutions.ur: Kyunke ye permanent fault hai, grid relay service centre se replace karwayein aur warranty claim ke liye note karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

title.ur: Battery discharge over temperature protection - discharge mein battery garm ho gayi (ID186)

meaning.en: The pack got too hot during discharge and shut down. Manual remedy: make sure the battery is within its normal temperature range, power off and wait 2 hours.
meaning.ur: Discharge ke dauran pack bohat garm ho gaya aur band ho gaya. Manual ka hal: battery apne normal temperature range mein honi chahiye, power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein.

causes.en: Discharging a high current in a hot environment with no ventilation.
causes.ur: Garm mahol mein bina ventilation ke high current discharge.

causes.en: Battery mounted in direct sunlight, or too close to a heat source.
causes.ur: Battery direct sunlight mein lagi, ya kisi garmi ke source ke bohat qareeb.

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature and the battery temperature shown on the LCD.
solutions.ur: LCD par dikhne wali battery temperature aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Power off and wait 2 hours as the manual instructs before trying again.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir dobara koshish karein.

solutions.en: Relocate or shade the battery and improve airflow, and consider derating the discharge current in hot months.
solutions.ur: Battery ko shift ya shade karein aur airflow behtar karein, aur garmi ke mahinon mein discharge current kam karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist
